page_title: LOR 1-1 MET | Lorient v Metz 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.

90+5' What a save from Jonathan Fischer! Bamba Dieng (Lorient) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
90+2' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) commits a foul and Guillaume Paradis immediately signals a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
87' Fine attempt! Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
87' The resulting set piece from Lorient is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' Substitution. Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) has come on for Georgiy Tsitaishvili.
85' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) replacing Boubacar Traore.
82' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Lorient players look gutted.
82' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Lorient players aren’t happy.
80' Goooooal! Pablo Pagis beats his man and slings in a cross towards Bamba Dieng (Lorient), who evades his marker and plants a fine header inside the left post from close in. 2:1.
79' Stephane Le Mignan decides to make a substitution. Ibou Sane will be replaced by Joel Asoro (Metz).
77' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Laurent Abergel as he is replaced by Dermane Karim (Lorient).
73' 1 - 1 Bamba Dieng (Lorient) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
69' Guillaume Paradis shows a yellow card to Koffi Kouao (Metz) for his blatant foul.

69' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Yvon Mvogo makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
68' Gauthier Hein (Metz) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
68' Wow, what an escape. Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play. Metz will have a chance to score from a corner.
67' Ibou Sane (Metz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' Ibou Sane (Metz) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' It must be a yellow card. It is. Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
62' Dangerous play by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient). Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Substitution. Sambou Soumano makes way for Mohamed Bamba (Lorient).
60' Olivier Pantaloni prepares a substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo is replaced by Bamba Dieng (Lorient).
60' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Jonathan Fischer is alert and denies him.
57' Gauthier Hein (Metz) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
56' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) commits a rough foul. Guillaume Paradis stops the game and makes a call.
55' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
51' The corner kick from Gauthier Hein (Metz) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
48' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
47' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
46' Stephane Le Mignan makes a half-time substitution. Alpha Toure (Metz) comes on in place of Jessy Deminguet.
46' The whistle blows and Guillaume Paradis starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Ibou Sane (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillaume Paradis had an easy-decision to make.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) is able to continue to play.
42' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
40' Lorient have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lorient are going to take it. Pablo Pagis (Lorient) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
37' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes the corner but it's cleared.
35' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Gauthier Hein (Metz) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
32' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

29' 0 - 1 Goal! Gauthier Hein sent in a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found the head of Sadibou Sane (Metz) and his precise header from around the penalty spot ended up in the bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
29' Gauthier Hein (Metz) will take the corner.
28' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
27' Malick Mbaye (Metz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

23' OFF THE POST! Pablo Pagis (Lorient) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
22' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle. Jessy Deminguet (Metz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
19' Fine play by Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
17' Gauthier Hein (Metz) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
15' A pass into the penalty area from Theo Le Bris (Lorient) is intercepted by the defence.

14' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jonathan Fischer has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.
9' Koffi Kouao (Metz) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
8' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
4' Neat passing move from Metz in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lorient will kick-off.
Guillaume Paradis is introduced as the referee for today's match.
